apps/desktop/src/lib/chat-visuals.ts.summary: Provides chat appearance helpers for deterministic username colors, dark-theme readability adjustments, SevenTV paint gradients or image backgrounds, and configurable timestamp formatting. Used by chat rendering to safely display platform colors, animated-style paints, shadows, and time labels.

apps/desktop/src/lib/kick-channel-identi.summary: Extracts and validates Kick broadcaster user IDs from avatar URLs or heterogeneous candidate values. Used to reconcile Kick channel identity when API responses expose different internal IDs.

apps/desktop/src/lib/twitch-playlist-ad-.summary: Detects advertisements in Twitch HLS playlists by analyzing ad markers, SCTE-35 and cue tags, discontinuities, segment hosts, bitrate changes, timing transitions, and clean baselines. Exports playlist diagnostic types, fingerprintTwitchPlaylist, and a scoped detector for classification, reported-miss fixtures, and baseline comparison.

apps/desktop/src/lib/twitch-rendition-co.summary: Selects and ranks Twitch HLS video renditions against a target resolution, frame rate, bandwidth, and codec profile, then aligns active and candidate playlists using program date-time or media sequence. Exports rendition filtering/ranking helpers and findTwitchPlaylistAlignment for stream continuity during playback transitions.

apps/desktop/src/search/channel-search-c.summary: Ranks and deduplicates channel search results across username and display name. Exports exact-match detection, fuzzy Damerau-edit matching, deterministic sorting, follower-count prioritization, and duplicate-quality selection for unified channels.

apps/desktop/src/shared/caption-source-t.summary: Type definitions for stream caption and subtitle discovery. Models track kind, language, broadcaster/platform provenance, stable source descriptors, and available, unavailable, or retryable-error states used by playback caption selection.

apps/desktop/src/shared/channel-account-.summary: Defines provider-authoritative account availability independent of live/offline presence. The ChannelAccountStatus union is shared across channel models and IPC to distinguish active, suspended, and unavailable accounts.

apps/desktop/src/store/chat-cosmetics-st.summary: Zustand store for chat badges, paints, role cosmetics, and provider-specific user assignments. Handles global badge loading, live 7TV cosmetic events, FFZ moderator/VIP badges, per-channel leases, cosmetic lookup, and cleanup when channels are released.

apps/desktop/src/shared/twitch-api-types.summary: Models Twitch channel, moderation, chat settings, bans, unban requests, polls, predictions, and EventSub moderation payloads, plus the discriminated TwitchApiCommand union for main-process API operations. Provides the typed capability boundary and standardized success/error result shape for Twitch Helix features.

apps/desktop/src/store/download-duplicat.summary: Zustand store for coordinating duplicate-download confirmation dialogs. Queues a single pending download request by job kind and title, then resolves it through the exported request helper and confirmation action.

apps/desktop/src/store/seek-interval-sto.summary: Persisted Zustand preferences store for configurable playback rewind and forward seek intervals. Exports storage/version constants and migration normalization that rejects invalid or unsafe values and restores the default interval.

apps/desktop/tests/adblock/fixtures/twit.summary: Documents the synthetic Twitch HLS playlist fixtures used by adblock tests, including privacy constraints and the use of reconstructed playlist structures and detection-signaling CDN hosts. Useful for finding fixture provenance, test data conventions, and sanitized Twitch playlist samples.

apps/desktop/tests/adblock/twitch-playli.summary: Vitest coverage for Twitch HLS playlist ad detection, including DATERANGE, cue-out, SCTE-35, ad-host, signifier, bitrate, sequence, timing, and host-transition signals. Verifies verdict classification, diagnostic fingerprints, clean-baseline preservation, and recovery behavior for the createTwitchPlaylistAdDetector and fingerprintTwitchPlaylist APIs.

apps/desktop/tests/adblock/twitch-rendit.summary: Vitest coverage for Twitch rendition selection and continuity during ad blocking or stream recovery. Tests resolution filtering, rendition ranking across frame rate, bandwidth, codec, and player type, plus playlist alignment using media sequence and program date-time through findTwitchPlaylistAlignment and related exports.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/api/platforms.summary: Vitest contract tests for authenticated Twitch follow and unfollow mutations using Xtra-compatible persisted GraphQL operations. Verifies accepted-but-unconfirmed writes, authorization failures, transient outages, network errors, and GraphQL rejection classification.

Vitest tests for the Twitch API service command dispatcher that maps allowlisted moderation, chat, channel membership, poll, and prediction operations to fixed Worker-relative Helix paths, HTTP methods, query parameters, and request bodies. Also guards that credentials and retry logic remain inside the request layer rather than IPC payloads.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/ipc/handlers/.summary: Security-focused IPC tests for authentication handlers. Covers trusted renderer origin checks, Kick-only credential reads and writes, Twitch credential isolation, malformed payload rejection, concurrent Twitch login deduplication, token lifecycle validation, and runtime user-record persistence.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/auth/twitch-d.summary: Security-focused Vitest tests for the Electron Twitch device-authorization popup. Verifies sandboxed BrowserWindow settings, Chrome user-agent masking, permission denial, canonical Twitch URL validation, and navigation allowlisting for Twitch, Google sign-in, OAuth, and localhost callback origins.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/ipc/handlers/.summary: Vitest test for the Electron main-process connectivity IPC handler. Confirms CONNECTIVITY_CHECK uses Electron net.fetch and returns a renderer-facing reachable result when the network probe succeeds.

Vitest coverage for Electron IPC platform-health handlers. Verifies health snapshot registration, degraded and recovered platform states, status-page details, renderer notifications, destroyed-window safety, and Kick failure-cache flushing only after Kick recovery.

Vitest coverage for proxy-related Electron IPC handlers and startup restoration. Tests sender-origin security for file:// and localhost renderers, rejection of remote or data URLs, write-only credential handling, credential-presence checks, and applying persisted proxy settings without exposing passwords.

Vitest coverage for Electron search IPC handlers across Twitch and Kick. Verifies platform selection, pagination, live-only filtering, parallel/partial search behavior, cancellation, result hydration, authentication enrichment, and normalized discovery result shapes.

Vitest coverage for the Electron slot-controller IPC bridge. Verifies host-to-main commands, slot load-stream dispatch, presence notifications, destroyed-window guards, WebContentsView routing, and multiview/background-quality behavior.

Security-focused tests for storage IPC account-follow mutations. Covers renderer-origin validation, payload sanitization, authentication gates, Twitch/Kick write routing, pending-write hydration, safe event forwarding, and failure logging.

Vitest tests for storage follow IPC handlers and platform-aware persistence. Verifies guest-versus-account source routing, rejection of unconfirmed local follows, pass-through add behavior, and Kick channel rename repair during follow hydration.

Vitest coverage for stream IPC handlers that retrieve top, category, followed, channel, and playback streams from Twitch and Kick. Tests unified registry routing, cross-platform merging and viewer sorting, partial failures, startup follow scans, playback resolution, and local follow/database behavior.

Vitest coverage for stream-recording IPC handlers and renderer boundary validation. Tests recording lifecycle routing, sender origin checks, malformed request rejection, stable stream identity requirements, recovery and interruption flows, state broadcasts, and public result discriminants.

Vitest coverage for system and window-management IPC handlers in the Electron main process. Tests app/version and prerelease metadata, minimize/maximize/close/devtools controls, theme detection, native notifications, external links, preferences, and live-notification coverage status.

Vitest coverage for Electron IPC timeout-moderation handlers, including development fixture routing, pending and failure states, packaged-production bypasses, sender URL authorization, and protection against unintended production service calls. Exercises snapshot creation and timeout submission through IPC_CHANNELS.MODERATION_TIMEOUT_* using mocked moderation services.

Vitest tests for AUTH_TOKEN_STATUS IPC registration and behavior across unauthorized senders, missing or invalid stored tokens, successful token validation, status reporting, and secret non-disclosure. Verifies coordination between storageService, tokenExchangeService, sender-origin validation, and the sanitized IPC response shape.

Vitest coverage for the Twitch API IPC capability boundary, testing trusted sender validation, structured read and moderation operations, credential-free service delegation, pagination cursor limits, and rejection of injected credentials or unsupported payloads. Confirms renderer requests are routed through the main-owned Twitch service without exposing tokens or client credentials.

Vitest coverage for Electron update IPC handlers, including channel registration, service initialization, update checking, downloading, installation guards, status retrieval, prerelease settings, and automatic-check configuration. Mocks update-service methods and verifies success, validation, and error-envelope behavior.

Vitest coverage for Twitch and Kick user-profile IPC routing through typed public-profile readers. Tests development fixture modes, packaged-app bypass behavior, unavailable-field responses, and delegation for identity, account creation, follows, and channel resolution.

Vitest tests for the IPC handler wrapper that registers ipcMain handlers and normalizes successful results and thrown errors into success/data or failure/error envelopes. Covers Error and non-Error throws plus undefined and null return values.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/ipc/sender-or.summary: Vitest security tests for sender-origin validation used to authorize Electron IPC callers. Verifies allowed production file URLs and loopback development servers while rejecting remote, data, blob, malformed, and deceptive localhost origins.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/ipc/video-han.summary: Comprehensive Vitest coverage for video and clip IPC handlers across Kick and Twitch. Tests cutoff calculations, cursor pagination, time filters, view-sorted deep fetches, page safety limits, playback and metadata routing, and registerVideoHandlers behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/ipc-handlers..summary: Integration tests for main-process IPC bootstrap and handler-group registration. Verifies registrar failures are logged without stopping later domains, Chat Replay and storage handlers receive required setup, and pending Kick writes resume during startup.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/chrom.summary: Integration tests for the Chromium log file tailer that forwards structured Chromium output to the project logger. Covers severity routing, filtering non-Chromium lines, truncation recovery, partial-line buffering, and idempotent stopping with real filesystem polling.

Integration tests for harmless Chromium ERROR filtering in the logging pipeline. Verifies GPU probes, DevTools Autofill failures, cache repair, transient SSL resets, tailer/intercept demotion to debug, and preservation of real WebRTC, SSL, and other errors.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/conso.summary: Tests the main-process console interceptor that routes console.log/info/warn/error/debug calls into the project logger. Covers level mapping, argument and Error formatting, custom tags, idempotent installation, uninstall restoration, and fallback behavior when logger calls throw.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/crash.summary: Tests process- and Electron app-level crash hooks that serialize uncaught exceptions, unhandled rejections, and renderer/child process failures into logger.error calls. Covers Error, object, primitive, and hostile Proxy rejection reasons plus listener cleanup and duplicate-install protection.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/log-p.summary: Vitest coverage for computeLogPaths, validating development and packaged log/bug-report directory selection across Windows, macOS, and Linux. Searches for environment-specific path rules, writable install directories, fallback logging locations, and absolute-path guarantees.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/logge.summary: Integration-style tests for the main-process logger, covering formatLine output, singleton initialization, filesystem log creation, session headers, current-log pointers, environment log levels, idempotent lifecycle behavior, and shutdown handling. Useful for finding logger formatting, electron-log transport, log file naming, and initialization error coverage.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/nativ.summary: Vitest tests for native Electron/Chromium stdout and stderr interception, including structured severity parsing, plain-text routing, multiline and Buffer handling, passthrough behavior, recursion prevention, idempotent installation, and uninstall restoration. Use this file to find Chromium console capture, process stream patching, logger integration, and duplicate-output safeguards.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/netwo.summary: Vitest coverage for installing the Electron DevTools Protocol network recorder and capturing stream-request initiator metadata. Verifies source-map resolution, generated versus mapped stack locations, request headers, URL fingerprints, and Network.enable setup.

Tests routing Chromium and Network:Request log-sink entries into the dedicated network logger while excluding unrelated application logs. Covers severity forwarding and preservation of optional metadata.

Vitest tests for Electron webRequest stream diagnostics, including playlist success/failure logging, signed-URL and authorization redaction, URL fingerprints, request timing, listener idempotency, and ignored hls.js aborts. Exercises installNetworkRequestLogger and DevTools initiator-hint correlation.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/noise.summary: End-to-end tests for the isolated high-volume noise logger used for HLS, chat, and player diagnostics. Verifies noise log paths, session headers and pointers, formatted metadata lines, log-level filtering, idempotent initialization, cleanup, and separation from the main logger.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/platf.summary: Vitest coverage for platform health telemetry logging, verifying JSONL transition records, per-platform state tracking, lazy telemetry-directory creation, documented fields, and non-throwing disk-write failures. Helps locate tests for platform-health change subscriptions and telemetry persistence.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/proce.summary: Vitest coverage for process monitoring, including stable RSS/heap/CPU/load snapshot formatting and interval scheduler behavior. Tests fake-timer boundaries, default intervals, idempotent cleanup, and replacement of duplicate monitors, helping find ProcessMonitor logging and lifecycle contracts.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/redac.summary: Vitest coverage for logging secret redaction via redactString and redactObject. Protects OAuth and bearer tokens, refresh tokens, client secrets and IDs, callback codes, JWTs, reversible Twitch clip media URLs, nested objects, and JSON-shaped strings while preserving safe values and non-string types.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/rende.summary: Integration test for renderer LOG_WRITE IPC payloads flowing through the main-process logger, validating file persistence, formatting, cleanup, and terminal filtering. Covers info, warning, and error levels with native stderr interception and Electron IPC mocks.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/rotat.summary: Vitest coverage for pruneLogs log-retention behavior, including directory creation, keep-count semantics, mtime ordering, zero-retention cleanup, invalid input, filename prefixes, and extension filtering. Helps locate tests for log rotation and filesystem pruning edge cases.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/logging/web-c.summary: Tests forwardWebContentsConsole for forwarding console-message events from arbitrary Electron WebContents instances into tagged project logger levels. Covers warning/error routing, legacy numeric levels, ignored informational noise, Pusher teardown demotion, metadata, and independent handlers for multiple views.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/protocols/twi.summary: Vitest coverage for the Twitch clip custom media protocol, including streaming, Range requests, safe headers, host validation, redirects, caching, backpressure, cancellation, and upstream failure handling. Exercises handleTwitchClipMediaRequest, TWITCH_CLIP_MEDIA_SCHEME_PRIVILEGES, and Twitch media URL construction.

Vitest coverage for the Electron Twitch image protocol, verifying mislabeled avatar bytes are detected and served with the correct JPEG content type. Also validates successful byte caching to prevent repeated upstream CDN requests.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/recovery/rend.summary: Vitest contract tests for renderer crash recovery, using an injected EventEmitter-based webContents fake. Covers reload behavior for OOM and killed renderer processes, ignores non-recoverable exits and destroyed windows, verifies uninstall cleanup, and checks structured logging.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/search/clip-s.summary: Search contract tests for clip matching, ranking, and deduplication. Defines the visible clip identity fields used for token matching and verifies exact channel identity, prefix matches, title fallback, popularity/date tie-breaking, and exclusion of creator/game metadata.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/search/progre.summary: Integration-style tests for progressive clip discovery across paginated channel and clip providers. Covers exhaustive pagination, repeated-cursor protection, cancellation, request accounting, rate-limit responses with Retry-After, and retrying the same search session.

Progressive stream-search tests covering native and directory provider fan-out, request-budget accounting, calibrated runtime profiles, concurrency limits, late provider results, pagination, and deduplication. These tests define how stream searches continue through nonmatching pages while matching visible fields and preserving failure progress.

Vitest coverage for progressive video search pagination, provider cursor exhaustion, deduplication, malformed-result filtering, request budgets, retries, rate-limit handling, cancellation, and session cursors. Uses mocked channel and video sources to verify how the progressive search engine fans out across channels and drains result pages.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/search/search.summary: Contract tests for unified search matching across channels, categories, and streams. Verifies token normalization, visible-field matching, fuzzy and prefix ranking, cross-platform category merging, deduplication, validation of malformed navigation data, and fallback image normalization.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/search/stream.summary: Vitest tests for deriving centralized stream-search budgets from Electron runtime observations. Ensures checked-in Twitch and Kick profiles are reproducible, all budget dimensions are observation-based, and calibration rejects incomplete platform data instead of fabricating limits.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/search/video-.summary: Contract tests for video search matching and ordering through rankVideoMatch and filterRankAndDeduplicateVideos. Covers title and channel-identity token matching, username discovery, exact and fuzzy match tiers, deduplication, and popularity/date tie-breaking.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/capt.summary: Tests durable caption preference hydration, migration, validation, and round-trip storage through storageService. Covers logical source/model/language/display fields, safe defaults for malformed legacy values, preservation of unrelated preferences, and exclusion of transient track keys or signed URLs.

Pins and verifies the reviewed English Zipformer 20M local caption model manifest. Guards model ID, revision, sizes, license, source metadata, artifact hashes, download URLs, and rejection of credential-bearing URLs.

Integration tests for LocalCaptionModelStore model downloads, SHA-256 and size verification, progress reporting, resumable HTTP range requests, staging cleanup, atomic activation, backup recovery, and preservation of a verified active model after replacement failures.

Tests normalizeNoDownloadCaptionPreferences for safely converting persisted caption settings when local model downloads are unavailable. Covers disabling legacy generated-local selections, retaining cleanup metadata and display settings, rejecting unsafe model paths, preserving platform settings, and applying safe defaults.

Tests captionUtilityEnvironment, which builds a restricted environment for the caption utility subprocess. Verifies runtime and temporary-directory variables are forwarded while tokens and unrelated process options are excluded.

Vitest coverage for LocalCaptionRecognizer, validating Sherpa streaming transcription, token-to-word boundary grouping, media-clock timestamp mapping, PCM acknowledgements, cue identity, revision increments, and phrase rotation after endpoint finalization.

Vitest coverage for LocalCaptionSupervisor, testing the single active local-caption lease, utility-process replacement and crash recovery, stale-child output filtering, bounded in-flight PCM backpressure, sequence validation, matching-session shutdown, and retryable error states.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/cert.summary: Vitest coverage for Electron certificate verification diagnostics, ensuring certificate failures log hostname and verification metadata without overriding platform trust, callbacks always receive -3, and diagnostics attach to the default and newly created sessions.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/chat.summary: Vitest coverage for BadgeResolver caching, Twitch global and channel badge hydration, GQL broadcastBadges precedence, subscriber-version resolution, refresh behavior, malformed badge handling, and serialized cache eviction. Searches for badge memoization, broadcaster isolation, Twitch Helix/GQL fallbacks, cache invalidation, and preserving enriched badge images.

Regression tests for Twitch IRC and Kick Pusher emote parsing, ensuring native emote fragments include isZeroWidth=false for consistent renderer overlay behavior. Covers parseTwitchMessage, parseKickChatMessage, wire-format emote extraction, and ContentFragment normalization.

Vitest coverage for converting Kick pinned-message payloads into the shared normalized pinned-message shape, including sender and pinner identities, IDs, timestamps, expiration, badges, defensive missing fields, and clickable URL content fragments. Searches for Kick pin normalization, pinned banners, badge parsing, URL detection, and Twitch/Kick parity.

Vitest coverage for KickChatService connection recovery, channel lifecycle, message sending, and Electron kickChat bridge integration. Searches for reconnect backoff, duplicate disconnect handling, shutdown cleanup, broadcaster user IDs, and actionable 401 errors.

Vitest tests for Kick event and message parsing, including badges, subscriber tiers, gifted-sub icons, emotes, links, mentions, official chat events, deletions, bans, raids, gifts, and subscriptions. Validates conversion from Kick wire payloads into unified chat message fragments and metadata.

Vitest coverage for normalizeKickPrediction, validating conversion of Kick prediction payloads into UnifiedPrediction objects. Covers status normalization, canceled/deleted states, outcomes, viewer votes and stakes, channel identifiers, terminal timestamps, winning outcomes, and defensive invalid-data handling.

Vitest coverage for Kick prediction lifecycle integration, including REST seeding, Pusher channel subscription, prediction event normalization, access-token forwarding, connection queuing, and acquire/release cleanup. Uses fake Pusher channels and mocked Kick predictions API to validate UnifiedPrediction emissions and channel identity.

Unit tests for converting Kick chatroom-updated WebSocket payloads into partial chat state patches. Covers followers-only, slow mode, subscribers-only, emote-only, account-age restrictions, disabled-mode null handling, combined updates, and partial payloads.

Tests 7TV Event API frame parsing and cosmetics client WebSocket behavior, covering badge and paint upserts, gradient and URL paint normalization, RGBA conversion, malformed data filtering, Twitch user assignments, entitlement deletion, and socket lifecycle messaging.

Tests subscriber-only eligibility preflight for Twitch and Kick, including Twitch token scope validation and Helix subscription checks, Kick subscription inventory parsing, matching channel identities, and unknown results for unavailable or ambiguous web-session data.

Vitest coverage for substituting third-party chat emote names in text fragments. Tests provider filtering, native-emote opt-in, whitespace preservation, fragment identity, animation/zero-width metadata, CDN URL fallback, and unchanged-array no-op behavior.

Vitest integration tests for TwitchChatService connection lifecycle and chat transport behavior using a mocked tmi.js client. Covers single-flight connection attempts, capped infinite reconnects, duplicate disconnect coalescing, intentional shutdown cleanup, message state handling, send/reply/action rate limits, and Twitch event processing.

Vitest tests for Twitch Hermes prediction-event parsing and WebSocket client lifecycle. Verifies ACTIVE/RESOLVED/CANCELED/LOCKED prediction normalization, outcome colors and predictors, channel ID threading for multiview subscriptions, anonymous viewer state, malformed-payload handling, and stop-during-connection behavior.

Vitest coverage for parseRawTwitchIrcLine, the Twitch IRC line parser. Tests PRIVMSG and USERNOTICE extraction, IRCv3 tag unescaping, badges, emotes, boolean coercion, ACTION messages, display-name fallback, malformed input, and channel validation.

Vitest coverage for Twitch chat message normalization helpers getDefaultColor, parseBadgeTags, and parseTwitchMessage. Verifies deterministic username colors, badge conversion, message types, bits, highlights, replies, emote/link/mention fragments, actions, IDs, and channel/user normalization.

Vitest coverage for Twitch pinned-chat polling and toNormalized payload conversion. Tests Electron bridge transport with direct GraphQL fallback, pin timing updates, event re-emission, deleted pinned messages, sender and pinned-by identity data, badge propagation, and rich emote fragments used by pinned-message banners.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/data.summary: Integration tests for DatabaseService SQLite initialization, schema creation, migrations, mod-log persistence, provenance, deduplication, and history coverage. Uses temporary databases and a node:sqlite better-sqlite3 shim to verify migration compatibility, idempotency, named parameters, and legacy data preservation.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/dire.summary: Tests direct streamed file downloads, including writing response bytes, reporting transfer progress, cancellation handling, and partial-file retention after disk-write failures. Covers DownloadCancelledError and .part temporary-file behavior for resumable or diagnosable downloads.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/down.summary: Behavior tests for completed-download file actions: reveal files in the OS folder, open files, remove queue entries without deleting files, and confirm physical deletion before removing entries. Verifies DownloadQueueService integration and missing-file or cancelled-confirmation handling.

Security tests for validating renderer-supplied media URLs before privileged downloads. Covers trusted Kick clip and video URL patterns, rejection of local/private hosts, insecure schemes, wrong ports or extensions, untrusted domains, and prohibition of renderer-provided Twitch playback URLs.

Unit tests for download destination naming helpers, including sanitizing usernames and titles into safe filenames and selecting numeric suffixes when a destination already exists. Covers buildDownloadFilename and getAvailableDestinationPath.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/chat.summary: Vitest coverage for converting Twitch IRC ROOMSTATE tags into chat-mode patches, including followers-only and slow-mode sentinels plus r9k, emote-only, and subscriber-only booleans. Protects the mapping used to update channel moderation state while ignoring unrelated tags such as room-id.

Vitest tests for the platform-agnostic chat replay service, covering Twitch adapter dispatch, bounded-window pagination, abort-signal forwarding, and Kick backward cursor traversal with chronological normalization. Documents replay capability responses, VOD locators, pagination direction, and VOD-boundary termination.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/clip.summary: Security regression test for default clip playback resolution, verifying that renderer-provided Kick media URLs are validated and untrusted localhost media is rejected before privileged HTTP or FFmpeg work. Covers the default resolver path used to obtain playable clip sources.

Vitest integration coverage for background clip downloads, including quality and save-path selection, persisted queue jobs, progress reporting, cancellation, Kick HLS/FFmpeg conversion, disk failures, retryable source preservation, and refreshed playback URLs. Exercises the service contract between playback resolvers, download queues, filesystem downloaders, and retry handling.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/conn.summary: Vitest tests for internet reachability checks, ensuring endpoint fallback, end-to-end 204 response validation, and abort-based timeout handling. Covers the connectivity service used to distinguish online access from captive portals, failed probes, and stalled requests.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/emot.summary: Tests the main-process BTTV API service that fetches global badges, global emotes, and Twitch-user channel emotes through Electron net.fetch. Verifies endpoint construction, JSON parsing, 404-to-null behavior for channels absent from BTTV, and propagation of network or 5xx failures.

Tests the renderer-side BTTV emote provider, including IPC access through electronAPI, Twitch-only and numeric-channel validation, channel/shared emote merging, BTTV-to-project emote transformation, owner metadata, animation flags, and CDN URL generation.

Tests EmoteManager provider orchestration, including platform-specific global-emote allowlists, legacy all-provider loading, user-emote merging and statistics, and non-fatal channel-provider failures without unhandled promise rejections. Covers Twitch, Kick, BTTV, FFZ, and 7TV integration behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/down.summary: Vitest coverage for the download queue service, including legacy stream-recording cleanup, enqueue and persistence defaults, pause/resume/cancel/retry/remove controls, progress updates, subscriber notifications, and transfer-speed calculation. Helps locate tests for queue normalization, persisted download state, lifecycle transitions, and progress tracking.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/emot.summary: Backend service tests for fetching 7TV user connections and the global emote set through Electron net.fetch. Covers uppercase KICK/TWITCH URL routing, parsed JSON responses, 404 null sentinels, HTTP failure propagation, and network-error handling.

Renderer/provider tests for SevenTVEmoteProvider channel and global emote loading. Verifies Electron preload IPC preference, direct API fallback, Kick user-ID requirements, flat 7TV emote_set parsing, channel-key tagging, global-emote marking, and graceful degradation on missing links or API failures.

Integration-style Vitest coverage for the main-process FrankerFaceZ REST service. Verifies badge catalog and global-set endpoints, room lookup preference for lowercased channel names with channel-ID fallback, parsed responses, 404 null sentinels, and 5xx error handling.

Renderer/provider tests for the FrankerFaceZ emote adapter exposed through electronAPI IPC. Covers Twitch-only channel behavior, global and channel emote transformation, multiple default sets, null/error fallbacks, animated and zero-width modifiers, owner metadata, and size-specific CDN URLs.

Vitest coverage for Kick channel emote retrieval, including persistent Electron sessions, request-slot coordination, normalized-slug single-flight behavior, TTL and stale-result caching, timeout deadlines, primary/channel endpoint fallback rules, authorization, and compact warning logs.

Vitest coverage for KickEmoteProvider emote transformation and loading. Verifies Kick-specific field mapping, subscriber-only flags, global/channel set classification, image URLs, Electron bridge usage, subscribed-channel ownership, and safe handling of missing or unavailable Kick endpoints.

Tests fetchKickUserSubscriptions, the guarded service for reading Kick subscribed channels through an already-ready web session. Covers JSON parsing, unavailable or expired sessions, malformed responses, readiness checks, logging, and containment of warmup failures.

Vitest coverage for the IPC-backed Twitch emote provider. Tests provider configuration without renderer credentials, global/channel/emote-set transformations, animated formats, 404 and API failure handling, token scope validation, authenticated user emote loading, pagination, and preservation of completed results when later requests fail.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/kick.summary: Vitest coverage for the scheduled Kick follow metadata refresh service. Verifies broadcaster-ID repair, manual-refresh throttling, startup execution, 15-minute managed intervals, and interval cleanup.

Vitest coverage for repairing legacy and renamed Kick follows using stable broadcaster IDs, avatar URLs, or slugs. Tests metadata persistence, verification caching across restarts, display-name preservation, playback slug resolution, and bounded verification backfills.

Vitest coverage for the Kick follow/unfollow write service and its persisted retry workflow. Exercises unconfirmed writes, trusted sync confirmation, duplicate intent reuse, identity-safe matching, retry timers, cancellation, terminal/auth-paused states, and renderer change notifications.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/emot.summary: Integration coverage for Twitch user-emote loading through the global EmoteManager and IPC API handlers. Verifies validated token identity, opaque-cursor pagination, provider merging, and graceful handling of capability failures while preserving global and third-party emotes.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/ffmp.summary: Tests FFmpeg path resolution and HLS download/recording behavior for the desktop media pipeline. Covers packaged ASAR paths, progress parsing, MP4-to-TS fallback, crash-tolerant partial recordings, no-clobber output, graceful shutdown, stdin pipe failures, and forced termination.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/http.summary: Behavioral tests for the shared RobustHttpClient used for resilient backend HTTP requests. Covers fetch option/header construction, timeouts, retryable network and server failures, non-retryable errors, retry exhaustion, and per-origin circuit-breaker state.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/kick.summary: Vitest coverage for KickLiveNotificationSource polling and relay dispatch. Searches for bounded concurrency, staggered public-slug lookups, duplicate slug deduplication, cached last-live fallback on transient errors, and online/offline callback translation for Kick notifications.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/live.summary: Vitest integration tests for LiveNotificationService and desktop notification helpers. Covers guest and account follow selection, silent startup seeding, offline-to-online notification transitions across Twitch and Kick, per-channel preferences, notification payload matching, polling, and mocked Electron notifications.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/mod-.summary: Renderer-side Vitest tests for modLogWriter's IPC-backed moderation log behavior. Covers retention-sweep initialization, IPC insert/query wiring, cross-source EventSub/local deduplication within a time window, Twitch channel.moderate translation, provider provenance, bootstrap idempotency, and retention handling with an in-memory bridge mock.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/mode.summary: Tests the timeout moderation service’s secure snapshot and submission workflow, including verified actor and target checks, exact binding, policy validation, revalidation, opaque IDs, TTL expiry, cancellation, retry handling, and concurrent submission deduplication. Covers Twitch and Kick adapter behavior and correlated moderation attempts.

Tests authorization for moderation-history access across Twitch and Kick, including guest denial, live token validity, identity matching, canonical scope checks, broadcaster and moderator roles, platform verification, channel resolution, and fail-closed behavior. Mocks storage, OAuth token exchange, and platform moderation APIs.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/stor.summary: Tests StorageService behavior with mocked Electron storage and DatabaseService, focusing on token-aware follow visibility, guest versus platform follow sources, account verification, metadata repair, pending follow-write retry delegation, and related preference or persisted-state handling. Verifies that stale or unverified platform data is not exposed through the storage facade.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/stre.summary: Vitest coverage for Electron stream proxy configuration and credential persistence. Tests proxy application, direct-mode fallback, invalid inputs, connection resets, error recovery, safeStorage encryption, base64 fallback, and write-only credential behavior for applyProxy, clearProxy, setProxyCredentials, and hasStoredCredentials.

Vitest tests for validating stream-recording output artifacts before accepting partial recordings. Verifies missing or empty files are rejected without spawning ffmpeg, while non-empty media is accepted only when ffmpeg can successfully probe it through createStreamRecordingArtifactProbe.

Integration-style Vitest coverage for direct-to-file stream recording lifecycle behavior. Exercises createStreamRecordingService with session journaling, owned section paths, recorder shutdown, discard safety, artifact identity verification, pause/resume continuity, playback identity resolution, progress persistence, commit intent, cancellation, and failure recovery.

Vitest coverage for terminal stream-recording outcome coordination, including in-app versus native notification routing, focus promotion, duplicate-click prevention, fallback behavior when native notifications fail, and session/artifact safety. Uses mocked session storage, recording file actions, identity verification, and timers to validate completed-recording UX.

Tests HLS master-playlist quality catalog parsing, normalization, audio-only rendition filtering, deterministic quality selection, Source preference, and abort-signal-aware playlist fetching. Covers the quality-resolution utilities used by stream recording and reconnect fallback.

Integration-style Vitest coverage for stream-recording reconnect recovery after recorder loss, validating cumulative duration, owned section files, reconnect gaps, quality retention or typed fallback, stream identity refresh, exhaustion handling, and prevention of unintended download-queue history. Builds mocked recorder, playback, quality-catalog, session-store, filesystem, and timer dependencies around the recording service.

Integration tests for explicit restart recovery of interrupted stream recordings. Covers resume versus finalize-only behavior, stream identity validation, quality fallback, gap creation, recorder restart, journal immutability on failure, and safe handling of missing or invalid preserved sections.

Tests the recording section finalizer that concatenates immutable TS capture sections into an MP4 and atomically commits the output. Covers SHA-256 artifact ownership, truthful TS fallback, ffmpeg failures, no-clobber destination handling, cleanup ownership, and exclusive-copy behavior.

Tests persistence, hydration, validation, and renderer snapshots for stream recording recovery journals. Covers versioned journal migration, owned section-path and symlink checks, restart and reconnect gaps, finalize-only legacy sessions, timestamp validation, URL secret stripping, malformed journal rejection, and durable terminal settlement.

Windows-only integration tests for stream recording recovery, pause/resume behavior, crash-tolerant MPEG-TS staging, and final MP4 playability using the real bundled FFmpeg. Exercises recording journals, interrupted session recovery, owned section paths, media validation, and cleanup of partial files.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/twit.summary: Unit tests for the Twitch EventSub feed service lifecycle. Verifies channel.moderate subscription setup, access-token and user scoping, safe event forwarding, connection-state notifications, unsubscribe cleanup, and fail-closed behavior without a valid token.

Unit tests for authenticated Twitch follow and unfollow mutations with authoritative post-write confirmation. Covers credential validation, same-account enforcement, refresh failures, authorization cleanup, synced-follow storage updates, and error classification for retryable versus reconnect-required failures.

Vitest coverage for TwitchLiveEventSubSource, testing authenticated EventSub subscriptions for followed channels, stream.online/offline notification dispatch, client ID propagation, subscription cleanup, degraded coverage fallback, and Twitch cost-budget limits.

Vitest tests for the TwitchManifestProxyService main-process HLS manifest proxy, covering enablement, activity state, statistics, stream cleanup, channel extraction, playlist parsing, ad-marker detection, and privacy-safe diagnostics and recovery behavior.

Vitest coverage for TwitchPlaylistFetchService, validating Electron session-based playlist fetching, HTTP error normalization, HTTPS Twitch m3u8 URL allowlisting, safe manual redirects, and cancellation through AbortController.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/upda.summary: Vitest coverage for the Electron update-service scheduler, including packaged-app gating, enabled/disabled auto-checks, daily/hourly/weekly frequency changes, persisted timestamps, retry behavior after failed checks, and runtime rescheduling through setAutoCheck.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/vaft.summary: Vitest tests for VaftPatternService, covering remote script initialization, regex-style extraction of ad signifiers, player types, fallback type, client ID, DATERANGE patterns, malformed input handling, rate limiting, backup URL fallback, persistence, and public detection APIs.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/vide.summary: Security-focused tests for resolveDefaultVideoPlayback, verifying fresh main-process Twitch/Kick VOD resolution, trusted Kick HLS fallback validation, rejection of private or untrusted media URLs, and protection against renderer URLs disguised as video IDs.

Integration-style unit tests for the background video download workflow, covering save cancellation, queued jobs, serialized ffmpeg execution, refreshed HLS playback URLs, progress completion, and failure persistence. Uses mocked queue storage and download dependencies to verify asynchronous job lifecycle behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/services/web-.summary: Tests the polling helper that waits for an Electron WebContents JavaScript predicate to become truthy. Covers timeout handling, destroyed WebContents, transient executeJavaScript failures, polling intervals, and successful readiness detection.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/shutdown-mark.summary: Verifies clean-shutdown marker persistence in Electron userData, including writing, existence checks, startup removal, shared path consistency, and filesystem error tolerance. Protects crash-recovery behavior when disk operations fail.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/startup/start.summary: Tests primary Electron instance startup coordination using the single-instance lock. Ensures secondary launches exit immediately while the primary runs pre-ready initialization and registers exactly one ready-phase startup callback.

Tests startup-session policy decisions based on whether the previous Electron session shut down cleanly. Confirms clean starts proceed silently, unclean starts warn while preserving Chromium cache, and every session is marked started.

apps/desktop/tests/backend/window-manage.summary: Unit tests the pure window-manager formatting and development-debugging helpers without requiring a real Electron runtime. Verifies compact, stable window snapshot JSON for log readers and ensures DevTools open only when explicitly requested.

apps/desktop/tests/components/auth/Accou.summary: Tests AccountConnect authentication UI states for pending Twitch disconnects and device authorization. Ensures in-flight actions are disabled, repeated disconnects are prevented, and authorization progress uses truthful phase-specific labels.

apps/desktop/tests/components/auth/AuthP.summary: Tests the AuthProvider boot contract: children render during and after auth initialization, authentication failures do not block application startup, and the follow store hydrates immediately on mount. apps/desktop/tests/components/auth/Guest.summary: Tests the GuestBadge component's conditional rendering and size styling based on the auth store's guest-mode state. Confirms non-guests see no output while guests receive a visible Guest badge with configurable typography.

apps/desktop/tests/components/auth/Login.summary: Tests the authentication login dialog for Twitch and Kick OAuth entry points. Covers open/closed rendering, successful login dismissal, and failed OAuth or network attempts keeping the dialog open for retry.

apps/desktop/tests/components/auth/Profi.summary: Tests authenticated profile dropdown navigation to the connected user's Twitch and Kick channels. Verifies platform-specific account identifiers produce in-app stream routes with the home tab selected.

apps/desktop/tests/components/auth/Recon.summary: Tests the moderator-permission reauthorization dialog across Twitch and Kick.
