apps/desktop/tests/components/search/Uni.summary: Comprehensive component tests for UnifiedSearchInput, including search submission, channel/category/stream tabs, category-disabled mode, debounced provider queries, pagination caps, deduplication, search history, favorites, live-only filtering, inactive tabs, and cross-platform autocomplete relevance. Uses hoisted mocks for infinite queries, router state, category linking, images, and history to exercise dropdown behavior and provider fallbacks.

apps/desktop/tests/components/settings/B.summary: Component tests for BugReportSection’s bug-report form and Electron preload bridge integration. Covers validation, log inclusion switches, successful report creation and saved-path display, failure toasts, unavailable noise logs, and opening the reports folder.

apps/desktop/tests/components/settings/C.summary: Regression tests for ChatSettingsSection preference controls, persistence, defaults, and visual previews. Verifies spread-preserving chatDisplay updates, timestamp formats, density and typography controls, removed fixed-width settings, fallback preferences, and accessible previews for appearance, emotes, and event groups.

apps/desktop/tests/components/settings/L.summary: Renderer integration tests for the LogsSection settings viewer and mocked electronAPI.logs preload bridge. Covers initial log tail rendering, level/tag filtering, current/noise/network file switching, network focus queries, DevTools-style network table view, clipboard interactions, and opening the logs folder.

apps/desktop/tests/components/stream/fea.summary: Vitest and React Testing Library coverage for the FeaturedStream hero carousel. Verifies loading and empty states, stream metadata, deduplicated tags, carousel navigation, platform-specific players and colors, muted preview audio, ad blocking, and autoplay interval behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/components/stream/rel.summary: Integration tests for ClipDialog seek controls across real Twitch and Kick VOD player paths. Verifies configured rewind/fast-forward intervals, timeline updates, quality source handling for Twitch, Kick clip loader configuration, and formatted playback time display.

Unit tests for the ClipDialog related-content playback modal. Covers guest sharing and downloading, readiness-gated actions, Twitch and Kick player selection, playback failure handling, history identity, clipboard URLs, and state reset when switching clips.

Component tests for native and HLS clip playback using mocked HLS.js and media elements. Verifies stable VOD buffering configuration, loading and source rendering, secure diagnostics that omit signed URLs, listener cleanup, play/pause toggling, and volume-store integration.

Navigation tests for ContentTabs that verify Home, Videos, and Clips links preserve the stream route while changing the hash-router tab query through client-side navigation. Covers TanStack Router hash history, pathname preservation, search state, generated hrefs, and prevention of document navigation.

Tests RelatedContent thumbnail prewarming across Home, Videos, and Clips tabs, verifying the first relevant image payload is sent to the viewport image cache before cards rely on lazy loading. Mocks channel video/clip APIs, router tab state, Electron storage, and proxy-aware image prewarm utilities.

Integration-style tests for the RelatedContent stream panel, covering loading skeletons, video and clip fetching, API errors, clip playback dialogs, platform-aware playback URLs, pagination limits, and deferred offscreen card rendering. Mocks TanStack Router, Electron APIs, cards, tabs, dialogs, and IntersectionObserver to validate related-content behavior.

Tests RelatedContent tab intent during pending TanStack Router transitions, ensuring cached videos or clips render immediately after a tab click while route loading continues. Also verifies settled and browser back navigation replace local intent with authoritative route state.

Unit tests for formatTimeAgo, including regression coverage that future Kick timestamps display as Just now instead of a negative age and invalid timestamps remain unchanged. Uses fake timers to make relative-time behavior deterministic.

Tests VideoCard navigation for live channel cards, verifying TanStack navigation targets the stream route and the main content scroll area smoothly returns to the top after navigation completes. Mocks image, avatar, router, and navigation dependencies.

apps/desktop/tests/components/stream/str.summary: Unit tests the StreamCard startup hover-prefetch guard, confirming Kick hover prefetch is delayed during the startup grace period while Twitch is unaffected and Kick resumes afterward. Covers the exported grace constant and predicate function.

Vitest component tests for StreamCard rendering and navigation behavior. Covers live badges, viewer counts, deduplicated tags, platform verification badges, watched-state styling, stream routes, and prevention of misleading freshness badges.

Tests StreamGrid loading, empty, error, stream rendering, and active picture-in-picture selection behavior. Mocks StreamCard and skeleton components to verify skeleton counts, consumer-provided empty messages, and platform/channel matching.

Regression tests for StreamInfo last-live metadata, ensuring elapsed time is measured from the stream end, hidden while currently live, and suppressed for missing or malformed timestamps. Uses fake timers and mocked UI dependencies to protect offline channel status behavior.

Comprehensive StreamInfo component tests covering loading UI, channel identity, verification badges, live versus offline metadata, follower counts, relative last-live timestamps, recording/follow action order, and owner-specific profile behavior. Mocks authentication and platform UI components while exercising live stream presentation rules.

apps/desktop/tests/components/ToastRoot..summary: Tests ToastRoot integration with Sonner notifications, including error and success messages with descriptions and StreamFusion dark-theme styling. Verifies rich colors are disabled and status-specific background and border classes remain readable.

apps/desktop/tests/components/ToastRootP.summary: Tests ToastRoot's global Sonner positioning so notifications appear below the title bar and top navigation on desktop and mobile. Mocks Toaster props to verify top-right placement and calculated offsets.

apps/desktop/tests/components/TopNavBar/.summary: Tests the global TopNavBar for branding, search, notifications, profile controls, sidebar collapse toggling, and intentional absence of a moderation link. Mocks app state and child navigation components to isolate top-level layout and interaction behavior.

Behavioral tests for the notifications dropdown, covering persisted live-stream notifications, empty states, avatars, relative timestamps, dismissal, clearing, read badges, and navigation to matching stream pages. Uses the notification store and router mocks to guard against demo rows and verify history preservation.

Component tests for the top navigation search bar, verifying search submission navigates to the search route with a query and that StreamFusion placeholder and KickTalk-inspired input styling are applied. Mocks UnifiedSearchInput and TanStack Router navigation.

apps/desktop/tests/components/ui/follow-.summary: Integration tests for authenticated Kick FollowButton account writes, covering authoritative follow/unfollow synchronization across stores and query caches, canonical and legacy channel IDs, pending-state sharing, IPC confirmation events, failures, auth pauses, hydration after restart, and concurrent renderer follows. Verifies StreamFusion account-write behavior, user-facing toasts, retryability, and preservation of unrelated Twitch/Kick follow data.

Unit tests for FollowButton interaction and routing behavior across guest, Twitch-authenticated, and Kick-authenticated contexts. Guards labels, icon-only state, event propagation, account-platform options, follow-source handling, and prevention of unnecessary external navigation or error toasts.

Integration coverage for FollowButton Twitch account writes, including confirmed follow/unfollow state, authoritative metadata hydration, transient failures, reconnect messaging, and separation of signed-out guest follows from authenticated account actions. Uses mocked Electron follow APIs, auth state, follow store, React Query, and toast notifications.

apps/desktop/tests/components/ui/proxied.summary: Behavioral tests for ProxiedImage URL handling across direct images, data URLs, Kick and Twitch custom protocols, browser-development relays, broken-image fallbacks, 1x1 placeholder detection, and session-level broken-URL caching. Verifies CDN-specific proxy routing and error callbacks without repeated failing requests.

apps/desktop/tests/components/ui/skeleto.summary: UI test for the Skeleton loading component, verifying it uses pulse animation while honoring the reduced-motion accessibility class. Helps locate motion-reduction behavior for loading placeholders.

apps/desktop/tests/components/ui/switch..summary: Component and CSS contract tests for the Twitch-styled Switch, covering track dimensions, thumb positioning, checked-state icon geometry, focus styling, and global CSS centering rules. Protects the custom sf-switch visual design from regressions or unintended theme classes.

apps/desktop/tests/config/electron-vite-.summary: Configuration boundary tests for electron.vite.config, ensuring sensitive Worker URLs are injected only into the trusted main process, development browser relays retain authenticated proxy settings, and the optional Twitch ad-frame proof route is development-only. Uses mocked Vite and Electron plugin configuration to validate build-versus-serve environment behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/browser-ele.summary: Vitest coverage for the browser Electron API development relay. Verifies nested method forwarding, correlated calls, Twitch/Kick user-profile and badge requests, query-string fixtures, event subscription cleanup, and same-origin playback URL rewriting.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/codec.test..summary: Vitest round-trip test for the development relay codec. Confirms tagged serialization preserves undefined values, Date, Map, Set, and ArrayBuffer runtime types across browser/Electron communication.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/host-bootst.summary: Tests development relay host startup selection. Ensures the privileged relay host starts only in the Electron renderer and is not duplicated when browser.html is loaded as a browser client.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/moderation-.summary: Tests moderation browser development fixtures and their production isolation. Covers moderation-role overrides, timeout snapshot/submission states, pending timers, failures, unavailable cases, and guarantees fixtures do not synthesize authentication or moderation data.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/relay-host..summary: Tests the Electron-side development relay host that dispatches browser RPC calls onto the public API bridge. Verifies request decoding, result encoding, nested method execution, event subscription setup, and unsubscribe cleanup.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/relay-rpc-c.summary: Tests the browser-side development relay RPC client. Verifies that encoded result messages resolve the matching pending call using correlation IDs, including transport behavior over a socket abstraction.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/twitch-ad-f.summary: Tests bootstrap failure handling for the Twitch ad-frame proof panel. Ensures import and synchronous mount errors produce diagnostics, remove partially mounted proof UI, and leave the normal application root untouched.

Vitest and Testing Library coverage for the Twitch ad-frame proof panel relay. Tests render failures, bootstrap timeouts, window errors, unhandled rejections, clean-frame readiness, and isolated player context behavior while ensuring normal StreamFusion UI remains intact.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/user-profil.summary: Browser fixture tests for the Twitch user profile popout and moderation actions using a simulated Electron relay, React Query, and Zustand stores. Covers profile identity, account creation, follows, moderation history, unavailable data states, retry behavior, guest eligibility, and channel actions.

apps/desktop/tests/dev-relay/websocket.t.summary: Tests development relay WebSocket connection recovery by simulating an initial socket error followed by a successful open. Verifies retry limits, delay handling, socket creation, and resolution of the working relay connection.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/00-app-.summary: MCP playbook that smoke-tests Electron startup, window discovery, title and version markers, sidebar rendering, renderer logs, and launch screenshots. Used as the initial health check before running page-specific playbooks.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/00b-sid.summary: MCP navigation smoke test for the desktop sidebar's Home, Following, Categories, History, Downloads, and MultiStream routes. Defines click and hash-navigation fallbacks, page sentinels, screenshots, and renderer-error checks.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/01-home.summary: MCP playbook for validating the Home page's category CTA, featured stream area, Live Now content, and API failure state. Includes route setup, DOM polling, screenshot capture, and renderer-log verification.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/02-foll.summary: MCP smoke-test checklist for the Following page, covering heading, All/Twitch/Kick filters, search behavior, and no-match empty state. Helps developers validate followed-channel rendering and capture visual evidence.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/03-cate.summary: MCP playbook for validating the Categories page, including unified-backend loading, heading, filter input, and typed no-match results. Used for interactive category-page smoke tests and screenshots.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/04-cate.summary: MCP scenario for opening the first category and verifying the category-detail route, back link, and stream grid or empty state. Covers category navigation and detail-page mounting.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/05-sear.summary: MCP smoke test for global stream search: enters a query, submits with Enter, verifies `/search?q=...` routing, and checks result-tab UI. Useful for finding search-input, navigation, and results-rendering regressions.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/06-stre.summary: MCP validation checklist for a live stream page, checking route mounting, video/player or offline state, stream information, and chat presence. Targets live-stream playback and channel-page integration.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/07-vide.summary: MCP playbook for VOD routes with title, channel, and duration search parameters, verifying metadata rendering and the VOD player container. Used to test video-page routing and URL-derived metadata.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/08-clip.summary: MCP scenario that opens a clip from a channel's Clips tab and verifies an in-page dialog without navigating to a `/clip/` route. Covers clip-card interaction, modal rendering, and route preservation.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/09-mult.summary: MCP smoke test for the MultiStream page, checking toolbar rendering, disabled focus layout with no streams, and the Add Stream dialog. Helps validate multistream layout controls and empty-state behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/10-hist.summary: MCP checklist for Watch History that verifies the heading and branches between an empty state and populated history with an enabled Clear History action. Used to test history persistence UI and conditional controls.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/11-down.summary: MCP playbook for the Downloads page, validating Active Downloads and Completed sections plus current hard-coded mock download items. Documents the temporary MOCK_DOWNLOADS contract until real download-store integration replaces it.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/12-sett.summary: MCP smoke test for Settings, covering version display, Twitch/Kick account controls, and optional ad-block switch state changes. Helps locate settings-page, account-connection, and playback-preference regressions.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/99-full.summary: End-to-end regression sweep that visits every major application route, captures renderer logs, and saves one screenshot per page. Intended for broad visual and JavaScript-exception checks after refactors.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/playbooks/README..summary: Index and conventions guide for interactive MCP E2E playbooks in the desktop app. Lists available page scenarios, required debug-electron-mcp calls, screenshot storage rules, execution behavior, and the standard Goal/Preconditions/Steps/Pass criteria structure.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/network-status-.summary: Vitest coverage for the network status store's retry and probe coordination behavior. Verifies capped infinite retry timing, browser online hints, concurrent probe coalescing, confirmed offline state, queued probes, and stale-result protection.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/browse-.summary: Comprehensive tests for post-paint browse-query snapshot hydration, including account-scoped Following streams, category/search caches, chat history, viewport image prewarming, identity changes, stale data, malformed persistence, and rejected IPC reads. Verifies exact TanStack Query key publication, offline cache behavior, cancellation, and logging during startup bootstrap.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/cache-p.summary: React hook tests measuring cache-hit behavior across stream, channel, category, search, followed-content, and history query surfaces. Builds QueryClient fixtures and seeds query keys to verify persisted or preloaded data is consumed without unnecessary network work.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/README.md.summary: Primary guide for the Electron MCP-driven end-to-end test suite. Documents debug-electron-mcp setup, fallback tooling, playbook execution and authoring, screenshot conventions, unit-versus-E2E boundaries, and troubleshooting.

apps/desktop/tests/helpers/better-sqlite.summary: Parity tests for the test-only better-sqlite3 compatibility shim backed by node:sqlite. Covers database construction, readonly options, prepared statement run/get/all behavior, positional and named bindings, upserts, pragmas, and closed-database errors so DatabaseService regressions fail at the API boundary.

Implements a Vitest-compatible better-sqlite3 replacement using Node 22's node:sqlite DatabaseSync, avoiding native Electron binary incompatibility during tests. Exports the default constructor and named Database alias with exec, prepare/run/get/all, pragma, transaction rollback, and close semantics used by DatabaseService.

apps/desktop/tests/helpers/database-test.summary: Provides createIsolatedDatabaseTestLifecycle for database tests that need temporary user-data directories and clean service initialization. It creates a unique temp directory, configures the database path, closes and nulls the service database, and recursively removes test state on disposal or initialization failure.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/chat-replay-pla.summary: Verifies the chat replay playback external-store pattern updates narrow playback subscribers without rerendering the owning video component. It exercises createChatReplayPlaybackStore and useChatReplayPlaybackSnapshot with React Testing Library and checks current time propagation and render isolation.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/chat-replay-win.summary: Tests selectVisibleChatReplayMessages, confirming replay chat visibility is rebuilt from video playback snapshots across playing, paused, seeked, and non-1x playback states. The fixture and visibleOffsets helper make timestamp-window behavior easy to locate when debugging chat replay synchronization.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/persist.summary: Tests the persisted channel metadata LRU cache used to restore platform-specific channel lookups across launches. Covers normalized platform and username matching, Kick chatroomId preservation, stale or invalid entry rejection, entry limits, byte bounds, and ignoring unusable saves.

Tests persisted browse-query snapshots used to hydrate recent search or category results. Verifies exact identity matching, TTL expiration, non-empty usability checks, versioned storage keys, and timestamped bounded writes.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/recent-.summary: Tests recent stream poster-image persistence and startup prewarming for Twitch and Kick routes. Verifies a bounded newest-first history of channel identities and forwarding stored poster URLs to the proxy-aware viewport image warmer.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useCate.summary: Tests category discovery hooks that merge Twitch and Kick catalogs, rank and bound results, persist restart snapshots, publish cached data quickly, and revalidate in the background. Covers provider completeness, partial failures, preview/exhaustive IPC orchestration, StrictMode deduplication, focus/timer behavior, invalidation, and disabled metadata lookups.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useChan.summary: Tests followed-channel and username lookup React Query hooks, including platform-aware IPC parameters, disabled guest queries, duplicate channel deduplication, error propagation, and stale follow metadata repair through the follow store. Provides coverage for Twitch/Kick channel fetching and canonical username synchronization.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useFoll.summary: Tests followed video and clip React Query hooks for filtering live streams, zero-duration placeholders, missing thumbnails, and Twitch processing thumbnails. Verifies merged results from followed channels are not capped at 60 items.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useHist.summary: Tests the query-backed watch history hooks that bridge the persisted history store with TanStack Query cache updates. Covers cache-hit and cache-invalidation performance telemetry plus add, remove, and clear mutations.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useInfi.summary: Tests infinite category stream queries, including category ID or name-based enabling, cursor-driven pagination, disabled empty inputs, and language-filter propagation through the IPC API. Protects against missing-cursor fetch loops and category slug fallback regressions.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useLive.summary: Tests the favorites adapter that queries saved channels and returns only currently live streams in saved order. Covers pending status aggregation, partial results, offline omission, and first-error reporting across multiple favorite queries.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useSear.summary: Vitest hook tests for channel, category, and progressive cross-platform search queries. Covers React Query caching, pagination, empty-query disabling, stale-result clearing, persisted result hydration, provider failures, request cancellation, timing telemetry, and StrictMode behavior.

Integration tests for the progressive useSearchClips hook across Twitch and Kick. Verifies tab-gated fan-out, cancellation and failure states, persisted LRU previews, cache performance budgets, stale-data reconciliation, metadata refreshes, and warm-cache retention.

Tests the useSearchStreams hook's progressive, platform-aware stream search behavior. Covers Live Only request identity, session restarts on query/platform/tab changes, cancellation races, background refreshes, cached fallback data, and protection against stale or non-authoritative empty responses.

Vitest hook tests for useSearchVideos, covering platform fan-out activation, persisted preview cache hits, stale-cache reconciliation, cancellation, failure and safety-limit states, and per-platform retry timing. Exercises React Query integration with mocked Electron search IPC and persisted search storage.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/queries/useStre.summary: Vitest coverage for stream query hooks including top streams, followed streams, channel-specific streams, cache updates, persisted snapshots, identity changes, platform-scoped keys, offline removal, and refresh intervals. Uses Electron API mocks to verify query errors, disabled states, deduplication, and live-status synchronization.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-ad-element-.summary: Hook tests for useAdElementObserver, verifying MutationObserver setup, cleanup, enable/disable behavior, and hiding existing or dynamically inserted ad elements. Documents the DOM selectors and visibility rules used to suppress player advertisements.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-app-shutdow.summary: Hook tests for useAppShutdown, validating Electron quit-event registration and cleanup, chat-service force shutdown for Twitch and Kick, shutdown state marking, and chat-store batching cleanup. Covers safe behavior when the Electron bridge is unavailable.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-chat-replay.summary: Tests the useChatReplay hook for Twitch and Kick VOD chat replay loading, locator forwarding, platform/video cache isolation, in-flight request deduplication, cancellation, and bounded seek-window eviction. Verifies historical replay stays separate from live chat store buckets.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-download-ac.summary: Tests duplicate download protection in the useDownloadActions hook for clips and VODs. Covers confirmation dialogs, cancellation via buttons, Escape, and backdrop, rapid-request handling, cancelled-job bypasses, and correct Electron download API calls.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-live-notifi.summary: Tests the bridge that receives live notifications from Electron and connects them to notification history, toast alerts, avatar rendering, and router navigation. Verifies preference-based toast suppression, cleanup subscriptions, proxied Twitch/Kick images, and desktop notification click behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-share-actio.summary: Vitest and Testing Library coverage for the useShareAction hook. Verifies public Twitch and channel-scoped Kick URL validation, clipboard copying, success/error toasts, two-second copied-state expiry, timer cleanup when links change, and retryable clipboard failures.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/use-stream-reco.summary: Vitest coverage for useStreamRecordingActions, the renderer action layer for Electron stream-recording IPC. Tests dedicated recording start, pause/resume, stop, completion-result handling, discard, interrupted-session recovery, active-recording blocking, typed failures, and recording-specific toast behavior.

Integration-style React Testing Library tests for StreamRecordingProvider and useStreamRecordingState. Covers shared IPC subscriptions, snapshot propagation, recording-phase transitions, one-second captured-duration timers, pause/resume controls, cleanup, quality announcements, and accessible live-region behavior for recording and recovery state.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useIsKickMod.te.summary: Tests the useIsKickMod hook for Kick broadcaster identity matching, legacy username fallback, observed moderator badge state, missing channels, signed-out users, and developer force-role overrides. Covers case-insensitive channel comparisons and store reset behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useIsTwitchMod..summary: Tests Twitch moderation detection through broadcaster identity and moderated-channel membership, including null or undefined channel IDs and signed-out users. Verifies that developer force-role overrides affect UI authority but not actual Twitch moderation authority.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useManagedTimeo.summary: Tests the useManagedTimeout hook as a cancellable, restartable React timer utility. Verifies latest-callback behavior, unmount cleanup, prevention of stacked timers, fake-timer timing, and referentially stable return values.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useModerationAu.summary: Tests authorization-aware moderation UI state across Twitch and Kick, including guests, checking, authorized, hidden, unverifiable, reconnect-required, and development-fixture states. Covers freshness expiration, complete versus partial or failed authority hydration, validated OAuth scopes, missing-scope reporting, and fail-closed token-status errors.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useModLog.test..summary: Tests the useModLog React Query hook and its Electron IPC integration for moderation history queries. Verifies loading, ready, verified-empty, partial-coverage, authorization-error, retryable, thrown-bridge, and malformed-response states, plus propagation of channel and filter parameters.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useAuth.test.ts.summary: Tests authentication hooks that combine Twitch and Kick connection state, initialize the auth store once, and select primary user information with a Guest fallback. Covers multi-platform login status, initialization guards, platform precedence, display names, avatars, and cold-start behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useChatSettings.summary: Integration tests for chat settings synchronization across Twitch and Kick, including platform-specific settings translation, stale duration cleanup, in-flight request deduplication, channel switching, reconnect refetches, and WebSocket event filtering. Uses mocked chat services, Electron APIs, room state, provenance tracking, and helper reset utilities.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useDebounce.tes.summary: Tests the useDebounce hook for immediate initial values, delayed updates, timer reset behavior where only the latest value wins, unmount cleanup, and generic non-string values. Uses fake timers and renderHook to validate debounce timing without real delays.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useElectron.tes.summary: Tests Electron integration hooks for retrieving app version and prerelease metadata, reading and subscribing to window maximization state, invoking minimize/maximize/close controls, and opening external URLs. Mocks window.electronAPI to verify IPC calls, async fallbacks, subscription cleanup, and desktop-specific behavior.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useHelixPoll.te.summary: Tests the useHelixPoll hook's immediate fetch, interval-based polling, enabled flag, visibility-aware pause and resume behavior, and manual out-of-band refresh. Uses fake timers and document visibility events to cover Twitch Helix-style polling lifecycle and background-tab efficiency.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useInterval.tes.summary: Regression tests for useInterval, verifying that callback changes use a stable ref without rearming the timer and that null delays pause scheduling entirely. Protects against timer thrashing and accidental zero-delay loops.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useNetworkStatu.summary: Tests the useNetworkStatus hook's confirmed connectivity detection using browser and main-process reachability signals, including offline retry state. Also verifies the debug override can simulate offline UI and reset to confirmed network status.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/usePlatformHeal.summary: Tests usePlatformHealth hydration and IPC change handling for Kick and Twitch platform health states. Covers degraded-state derivation, status-page detail storage/removal, initial defaults, and unsubscribe cleanup.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useRequireModSc.summary: Tests Twitch moderation permission checks exposed by useRequireModScopes, including required action scopes, EventSub scope alternatives, missing-token and fetch-error behavior. Also verifies reconnect dialog prompting, callback forwarding, and stable promptReconnect identity.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useResolveTwitc.summary: Tests useResolveTwitchChannel's React Query integration for resolving a Twitch channel login into channel metadata through the Electron Twitch API or Helix fallback. Covers empty input, successful resolution, HTTP authorization/not-found failures, and empty API results.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useSearchHistor.summary: Tests useSearchHistory's scoped, persistent search-history behavior for channels, categories, and streams using localStorage. Covers legacy-format migration, deduplication, ordering, size limits, tab-specific clearing, empty input handling, and corrupt storage recovery.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useStickyDismis.summary: Tests the useStickyDismissedPrediction hook’s dismissal gate: prediction IDs remain visible until dismissed, repeated emissions for the dismissed ID are suppressed, new IDs clear suppression, and returned callbacks stay referentially stable.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useStreamPlayba.summary: Tests confirmed network-recovery behavior for useStreamPlayback, including retrying failed playback once after recovery, resetting reload limits, ignoring empty or healthy streams, and preserving recovery events observed during stale in-flight requests.

Comprehensive tests for useStreamPlayback playback URL loading, offline errors, empty identifiers, shared in-flight requests, memory caching, reload propagation, prefetch warming, stagger behavior, and privacy-safe URL logging across subscribers.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useTimeout.test.summary: Tests the useTimeout hook’s timer semantics: callback changes update the invoked callback without re-arming the timer, while a null delay pauses scheduling entirely.

apps/desktop/tests/hooks/useUpdater.test.summary: Tests updater store integration with the Electron updater API, covering status hydration, check/download/install actions, error handling, prerelease and automatic-check settings, progress events, status subscriptions, initialization, and missing-API no-ops.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/cross-logger.test.summary: Tests the process-safe cross-logger used by renderer-reachable and dual-use Electron modules. Covers main sink forwarding and precedence, renderer electronAPI bridge logging, console fallback behavior, metadata handling, and protection against sink, bridge, or console failures.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/duration.test.ts.summary: Tests parseDurationSeconds conversion for Twitch/Kick video and clip duration formats. Covers colon-separated timestamps, compact hour/minute/second strings, plain seconds, and invalid zero-duration handling.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/error-toast.test..summary: Tests showErrorToast operational error notifications with copyable title and description details. Verifies 15-second toast duration, clipboard success feedback, and contained clipboard failures that produce a readable non-copyable error toast.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/id-utils.test.ts.summary: Tests channel and stream identity matching and deduplication across Twitch and Kick. Covers platform isolation, renamed channels, missing IDs, case-insensitive usernames, legacy Kick ID mismatches, and retention of richer channel metadata.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/live-notification.summary: Tests live notification preference defaults and eligibility rules for followed Twitch and Kick channels. Covers global alerts, platform toggles, guest follows, favorites-only mode, and per-channel notification overrides.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/proxied-image-url.summary: Tests platform image URL allowlisting and environment-specific proxy resolution. Verifies exact HTTPS Kick CDN host matching, rejection of HTTP and hostname-confusion attacks, Electron custom protocols, and the browser development media relay.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/sleep.test.ts.summary: Tests createCancellableSleep for timer-based asynchronous delays with explicit success and cancellation outcomes. Covers repeated cancellation safety, physical timer disposal, Node timer unref support, and browser-compatible timers without unref.

apps/desktop/tests/lib/stream-route-prel.summary: Integration test for Stream route intent preloading through the real page loader and nested ChatPanel lazy boundary. Ensures preload readiness waits until the nested chat module resolves, preventing premature route transition or loading completion.

Defines the eight performance rule sections, their filename prefixes, ordering, impact levels, and descriptions. Used by the build process to group rules such as async waterfall prevention, bundle optimization, server performance, rendering, and JavaScript hot-path tuning.

Markdown template for creating individual React and Next.js performance rules, with frontmatter fields for title, impact, impact description, and tags plus incorrect/correct code examples and references. Provides the canonical structure consumed by validation and compilation scripts.

Explains why useEffectEvent results should not appear in useEffect dependency arrays and demonstrates the correct dependency pattern using only reactive values such as roomId. Prevents unnecessary effect reruns and React Hooks lint errors in subscription or connection-based components.

Explains how to keep event subscriptions stable while accessing the latest callback through refs or React’s useEffectEvent. Useful for custom event hooks, effect dependency optimization, and avoiding unnecessary addEventListener/removeEventListener cycles.

Documents safe patterns for app-wide initialization that must run once per application load instead of once per component mount. Covers module-level guards and top-level startup logic for storage loading, authentication checks, and other side effects.

Shows how to use useEffectEvent to read the latest callback values without adding unstable functions to effect dependency arrays. Applies to debounced searches, timers, subscriptions, and other effects that should not restart on every callback change.

Guides API routes and Server Actions toward dependency-aware asynchronous execution to prevent request waterfalls. Covers starting independent work early and combining dependent results with Promise.all or better-all.

Explains how to evaluate inexpensive synchronous guards before awaiting remote feature flags or other asynchronous values. Prevents unnecessary network, cache, or database work when the local condition already rules out the branch.

Recommends moving awaits into only the branches that need their results, especially after early returns such as skip, not-found, or authorization checks. Helps reduce latency and avoid expensive unused data fetching in request handlers.

Describes dependency-based async parallelization with better-all or manually constructed promise chains. It helps overlap independent work while starting dependent operations as soon as their prerequisites resolve.

Defines the basic Promise.all pattern for running independent asynchronous operations concurrently instead of sequentially. Intended for API handlers, data loaders, and any code with multiple unrelated network or database requests.

Shows how strategic React Suspense boundaries let layout and wrapper UI render while data-dependent components stream in later. Covers loading fallbacks, shared promises, use(), and trade-offs involving layout shift, SEO, and critical content.

Explains why dynamic imports and filesystem paths should remain statically analyzable so bundlers and Next.js output tracing can identify reachable files precisely. Provides explicit module maps and literal path patterns to prevent oversized bundles, slower builds, and broader cold-start dependencies.

Recommends avoiding broad barrel-file imports when they force bundlers or runtimes to load many unused re-exports. Covers Next.js optimizePackageImports, direct imports, tree-shaking limits, and performance impacts for component, icon, utility, and date libraries.

Documents conditional loading for large modules or data that are needed only after a feature is activated. The example uses a browser-only dynamic import for animation frames, with loading, failure, and SSR considerations.

Shows how to defer non-critical analytics, logging, and error-tracking libraries until after hydration so they do not delay initial interaction. Uses Next.js dynamic imports with SSR disabled for client-only third-party code.

Explains using next/dynamic to code-split heavy components such as Monaco Editor that are not required for the initial render. Focuses on reducing initial JavaScript, improving TTI/LCP, and disabling SSR when appropriate.

Describes preloading heavy code in response to user intent, such as hover, focus, button interaction, or an enabled feature flag. Helps reduce perceived latency while preserving SSR and initial-bundle efficiency.

Presents a shared-subscription pattern for deduplicating global browser event listeners across multiple React hook instances. Uses a module-level callback registry and useSWRSubscription for keyboard shortcuts and similar client-wide events.

Guidelines for versioning and minimizing localStorage data to prevent schema conflicts, reduce storage size, and avoid persisting sensitive fields. Covers migration, error handling, and storing only UI-required fields.
Explains when to mark touch and wheel event listeners as passive to eliminate scroll delays. Distinguishes tracking listeners from gesture handlers that require preventDefault().
Recommends SWR for shared request deduplication, caching, and revalidation across React component instances. Includes immutable-data hooks and mutation patterns for API fetching.

Shows how to prevent browser layout thrashing by batching DOM style writes and layout reads, or by toggling CSS classes. Applies to imperative DOM code and React effects involving reflow-triggering properties.

Describes module-level Map caching for repeated function calls with identical inputs, including single-value caches and invalidation after state changes. Useful for expensive computations in renders, utilities, and event handlers.
Recommends caching frequently accessed object properties and array lengths inside hot loops to reduce repeated lookups. Focuses on low-level JavaScript loop optimization.

Provides patterns for caching synchronous localStorage, sessionStorage, and cookie reads in memory to reduce expensive repeated I/O. Covers keeping caches synchronized and invalidating them after cross-tab or visibility changes.
Shows how to replace multiple filter or map passes with one loop that builds several result collections. Targets array-processing performance by reducing repeated iterations.
Explains early returns for validation and search logic when the final result is already known. Prevents unnecessary processing after the first failure or matching condition.
Recommends flatMap for transforming and filtering arrays in one pass without an intermediate mapped array. Includes patterns for conditional extraction, parsing, and skipping invalid results.

Guidelines for hoisting reusable regular expressions or memoizing dynamically generated patterns instead of constructing them during every React render. Also warns about mutable lastIndex state in global regexes.
Shows how to build a Map index for repeated lookups by identifier, replacing repeated O(n) find calls with O(1) access. Useful for joining related arrays such as orders and users efficiently.

Recommends checking array lengths before expensive equality or comparison work, then returning early on mismatches. Covers non-mutating sorting, deep comparison, allocation reduction, and early difference detection.
Explains how to find minimum and maximum values with a single O(n) loop instead of sorting the entire array. Includes empty-array handling and guidance for when Math.min or Math.max is appropriate.
Describes deferring analytics, persistence, prefetching, and other non-critical work with requestIdleCallback to keep the UI responsive. Covers timeouts, chunking large tasks, and browser fallbacks.
Explains replacing repeated array membership checks with Set or Map lookups for O(1) performance. Provides JavaScript examples for filtering collections by allowed IDs.
Documents immutable array sorting with toSorted() to prevent React prop and state mutation bugs. Covers browser fallback and related immutable array methods.
Shows how React Activity preserves component state and DOM when expensive UI is toggled between visible and hidden. Useful for dropdowns and frequently shown or hidden components.
Recommends animating a wrapper element instead of an SVG directly to improve browser hardware acceleration for transforms, opacity, and transitions. Includes a loading-spinner pattern.
Explains explicit ternary rendering in JSX when falsy values such as 0 or NaN could otherwise appear in the UI through && expressions. Uses a numeric badge example.
Shows how CSS content-visibility and contain-intrinsic-size defer layout and painting for off-screen items in long lists. Targets message feeds and other large scrollable collections.
Recommends moving static JSX elements outside components to avoid recreating expensive markup on every render. Covers loading skeletons and large SVG nodes, with a React Compiler caveat.

Provides an inline-script pattern for applying localStorage-backed themes or preferences before React hydration, preventing SSR failures, hydration mismatch, and visual flicker. Applies to theme, auth, and client-only state.
Explains when to use suppressHydrationWarning for intentional server/client differences such as timestamps, random IDs, and locale formatting. Warns against hiding genuine hydration bugs.
Documents React DOM resource hint APIs for DNS prefetching, preconnect, preload, and module or stylesheet initialization. Helps optimize critical fonts, scripts, APIs, CDNs, and likely next routes.
Explains choosing defer versus async on script tags to prevent render-blocking downloads and execution. Includes DOM-dependent, analytics, and Next.js next/script patterns.
Recommends reducing SVG coordinate precision with SVGO to shrink asset file sizes while preserving sufficient visual accuracy. Includes a command-line optimization example.
Shows how useTransition supplies pending UI state for responsive asynchronous updates instead of manually managed loading state. Targets search results and other non-urgent React updates.
Recommends reading dynamic values such as URL search parameters on demand inside callbacks when components do not need to react to every change. Reduces unnecessary subscriptions and re-renders.
Explains narrowing useEffect dependencies from whole objects or continuously changing values to the primitive or derived boolean actually used. Reduces unnecessary effect executions.

Shows how to calculate values derived from props or state during render instead of storing redundant state and synchronizing it in useEffect. Prevents extra renders and state drift in forms and similar components.
Recommends subscribing to a derived boolean, such as a media-query result, instead of continuously changing source values like window width. Reduces render frequency for responsive components.
Documents functional setState updates for callbacks and async handlers that depend on current React state. Prevents stale closures, reduces callback dependencies, and keeps event handlers stable.
Explains React lazy useState initialization for expensive initial values such as storage reads, indexes, DOM access, and transformations. Helps prevent unnecessary computation during rerenders.
Documents how unstable default arrays, objects, or functions break React memoization. Shows how to extract stable constants for optional non-primitive component parameters.
Shows how to extract expensive work into memoized child components so loading and early-return paths skip unnecessary computation. Covers memo, useMemo, and React Compiler considerations.
Explains when interaction-driven side effects belong directly in event handlers instead of state plus useEffect. Prevents duplicate actions and unrelated effect reruns caused by dependency changes.

Warns against defining React components inside parent components because each render creates a new component type and remounts the subtree. Covers lost state, focus, effects, animations, and scroll position.
Guides developers to avoid useMemo for cheap expressions returning primitive values such as booleans, strings, or numbers. Reduces unnecessary hook overhead and dependency comparisons.
Shows how to split independent useMemo or useEffect computations with different dependencies. Prevents unrelated filtering, sorting, analytics, or document updates from recomputing together.
Explains using startTransition for frequent non-urgent updates, such as scroll tracking, to keep urgent UI interactions responsive. Includes event listener setup and cleanup patterns.
Documents useDeferredValue for keeping search inputs responsive while expensive filtering, visualization, or derived rendering catches up. Covers memoized computation and stale-result indicators.
Shows when frequently changing transient values should live in useRef instead of useState to avoid rerenders. Covers mouse tracking, interval state, DOM refs, and direct style updates.

Explains Next.js after() for scheduling logging, analytics, notifications, cache invalidation, and cleanup after a response is sent. Helps server handlers avoid blocking response delivery on non-critical work.

Defines the security pattern for authenticating and authorizing every Next.js Server Action as if it were a public API endpoint. Covers input validation, session checks, role checks, and protected mutations.

Documents cross-request LRU caching for sharing database results across sequential server requests. Covers TTL, capacity, Vercel Fluid Compute behavior, and when distributed storage such as Redis is needed.

Explains React.cache() for deduplicating authentication, database, filesystem, and other async work within a single server request. Covers shallow argument equality, stable primitive parameters, and Next.js fetch memoization.

Explains how to avoid duplicate React Server Component prop serialization by preserving object references and moving client-side transformations such as sorting, filtering, and mapping. Useful for optimizing RSC payloads and client component boundaries.

Documents hoisting static asset, configuration, template, and font I/O to module scope so route handlers and server functions do not repeat reads on every request. Applies to Next.js route handlers, OG image generation, serverless functions, and cached static resources.

Shows how to prevent request data leaks and concurrency races caused by mutable module-level state in React Server Components and SSR. Covers request-local data flow, safe static exceptions, and correctly keyed shared caches.

Presents component composition patterns for running independent React Server Component data fetches in parallel instead of creating server-side waterfalls. Useful for Next.js layouts, pages, headers, sidebars, and children-based composition.

Explains how to parallelize nested per-item fetches by chaining dependent requests inside each item’s promise, preventing one slow record from blocking unrelated nested data. Applies to chat-author loading, list enrichment, and Promise.all data pipelines.

Guides developers to minimize data passed across React Server Component and client component boundaries by serializing only fields the client actually uses. Helps reduce HTML and RSC payload size and improve page load performance.

.agents/skills/vercel-react-native-skill.summary: Comprehensive React Native performance and correctness guide for AI-assisted development, covering rendering safety, virtualized lists, animations, scrolling, navigation, state architecture, React Compiler, styling, native UI, design systems, monorepos, dependencies, JavaScript, and fonts. Organized as prioritized rules with incorrect and corrected examples for refactoring and code generation.
Repository overview for a React Native best-practices skill. Documents rule categories, naming conventions, impact levels, file structure, and how to create new performance and UI guidance rules.

Agent-facing instructions for applying React Native and Expo best practices. Organizes guidance by priority across list performance, animations, navigation, UI, state, rendering, monorepos, and configuration, with references to individual rule files.

Metadata manifest for the React Native performance optimization guide. Defines version, organization, publication date, scope, rule count, and authoritative documentation references used by the skill.

Section registry for organizing React Native rules by filename prefix, priority, impact, and description. Defines the taxonomy covering rendering, lists, animation, navigation, state, UI, design systems, monorepos, imports, JavaScript, and fonts.

Authoring template for new React Native best-practice rules. Specifies YAML frontmatter, impact metadata, incorrect-versus-correct examples, explanations, and reference links so added rules follow the repository format.

Guideline for deriving Reanimated shared values declaratively with useDerivedValue instead of useAnimatedReaction. Clarifies that useAnimatedReaction is intended for side effects and highlights dependency tracking and React Compiler-compatible accessors.

Guideline for implementing animated press feedback with GestureDetector and Gesture.Tap on the UI thread. Covers shared-value press state, derived scale animation, worklets, and runOnJS for invoking JavaScript callbacks.

Performance rule for animating transform and opacity instead of layout properties such as width, height, margin, or position. Prevents per-frame layout recalculation and provides Reanimated patterns for collapsible and slide animations.

Design-system guidance for using explicit compound components such as Button, ButtonText, and ButtonIcon instead of polymorphic string-or-node children. Improves composability, text rendering clarity, and component API consistency.

Expo font-loading rule recommending the expo-font config plugin to embed fonts during native builds. Eliminates asynchronous runtime font loading and startup loading states, with app configuration and prebuild guidance.

Architecture rule for importing UI dependencies through a project design-system folder rather than directly from third-party packages. Uses re-exports or thin wrappers to centralize implementation changes and simplify future refactoring.

Guideline for improving React render performance by hoisting static Intl.DateTimeFormat, NumberFormat, and RelativeTimeFormat instances out of renders and loops. Covers module-scope formatters and useMemo for locale-dependent formatting.
Guideline for reducing virtualized-list re-renders by keeping item callbacks stable and hoisting callback creation to the list level. Applies to LegendList renderItem handlers and memoized list rows.

Guideline for preserving stable item and object references passed to virtualized lists so unchanged rows can avoid re-rendering. Covers parent-level transformations, Zustand selectors, stable arrays, and deriving dynamic values inside list items.

Guideline for preventing list scrolling and memory problems by loading compressed, appropriately sized thumbnails instead of full-resolution images. Covers CDN resize parameters, retina sizing, caching, placeholders, and expo-image/SolitoImage.

Guideline for avoiding inline object and style creation inside renderItem because new references defeat memoization and trigger unnecessary row renders. Recommends passing items or primitives directly and hoisting static styles.

Guideline for keeping virtualized list rows lightweight by moving queries, expensive computations, and broad context access into the parent. Recommends primitive props, minimal hooks, and Zustand selectors for targeted shared state.

Guideline for making memoized list rows effective by passing only the primitive values each item needs instead of unstable object props or inline callbacks. Explains shallow comparison, child-owned handlers, and React Compiler considerations.

Guideline for optimizing heterogeneous LegendList feeds with discriminated item types and getItemType recycling pools. Covers type-safe rendering, separate layouts, item recycling, and per-type size estimation.

Guideline for using LegendList or FlashList instead of ScrollView with mapped children so only visible rows mount. Applies virtualization as the default for feeds, profiles, settings, search results, and other scrollable content.

Guideline for fixing React Native monorepo autolinking failures by declaring native dependencies in the actual app package, even when shared packages also use them. Explains that autolinking scans the native app's node_modules.

Guideline for preventing duplicate bundles and dependency conflicts by enforcing one exact version of each dependency across a monorepo. Covers syncpack, package-manager overrides/resolutions, and avoiding version ranges.

Guidelines for configuring React Native and Expo Router navigation with platform-native stack and tab navigators. Covers native performance, headers, safe areas, gestures, accessibility, and replacing JavaScript-based navigator implementations.

React Compiler guidance for destructuring hook-provided functions at render scope to preserve stable references and memoization. Applies to callbacks using router, navigation, or other object-based APIs.

React Compiler compatibility guidance for Reanimated shared values, requiring get() and set() instead of direct .value access. Helps preserve compiler tracking when implementing animated counters and shared state.

React useState patterns for updates that depend on current state, using functional dispatch updaters to avoid stale closures. Covers object equality checks, skipped re-renders, and safe callback state updates.

Pattern for representing user intent separately from fallback values by initializing state as undefined and resolving with nullish coalescing. Keeps components reactive to changing parent or server-provided defaults without synchronization effects.

Guidance for keeping React state minimal and deriving computable values from props or existing state during render. Prevents redundant state, synchronization effects, unnecessary re-renders, and state drift in components such as carts and forms.

React Native JSX safety rule for avoiding && with potentially renderable falsy values such as 0 or empty strings. Recommends explicit booleans, ternaries, early returns, and linting to prevent production crashes outside Text components.
React Native rendering rule requiring all string content to be wrapped in Text components. Prevents the runtime error caused by placing raw text directly inside View or other non-Text containers.

Performance guidance for tracking ScrollView position with Reanimated shared values or refs instead of useState. Prevents per-frame re-renders, scroll jank, and dropped frames while supporting animated and non-reactive scroll tracking.

State modeling principle for storing real interaction or application state and deriving visual outputs such as scale, opacity, height, and translation. Applies to React state and Reanimated shared values to maintain a single source of truth and extensible animations.

React Native image guidance favoring expo-image over the core Image component for caching, memory efficiency, placeholders, progressive loading, and list performance. Documents image props for blurhash, content fitting, transitions, priority, cache policy, and recycling.
